name: Maurice Trintignant
features: olive skin, dark hair receding at the temples, dark eyes, long narrow face, prominent nose, lean build, wry patient expression
bio: Known throughout his career as ‘Le Pétoulet’ after rats nested in the fuel tank of his stored Bugatti and cost him a race in 1945. He won Monaco twice, in 1955 and 1958, and Le Mans in 1954 with José Froilán González, then drove fifteen Formula One seasons for eleven different marques before going home to make wine in the Vaucluse.
